name: humid_air_1691_whf_dry_control_starts
description: Dry night (outdoor dew point 50F): the same window opening starts the whole-house fan (control: the guard does not block dry air)
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 76.0F at 50.0% = 56.01F; outdoor 70.0F at 49.1% = 50.01F. Ceiling = default 65F (option On).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: a guard that blocked every night (e.g. an inverted comparison) fails this control. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: a dry night keeps its free cooling; the AC does not run instead of the fan.

verdict.summary: Dry night (outdoor dew point 50F): the same window opening starts the whole-house fan (control: the guard does not block dry air)

events.note: Summer evening, windows closed: outdoor cooler than the house, so free cooling is on offer by temperature.
Hot day, cool mode: with the windows closed the AC holds the band (no fan starts in a sealed house).
Five minutes later, same air: the engine re-asks the start question (paused-reactivation / idle-open re-check).

assertions.reason: Windows closed: the cool band is armed and the AC holds it.
Dry night (outdoor dew point 50F): the same window opening starts the whole-house fan (control: the guard does not block dry air)
Free cooling runs on dry air.
